newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong long bond yields up,interbank rates down.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong long bond yields up,interbank rates down.

text.p: Hong Kong long-end government bonds yielded slightly higher in line with U.S. Treasuries while short-dated bill yields and interbank cash rates slipped on eased liquidity, dealers said on Thursday.
Yields for seven-year Exchange Fund notes edged up to 7.01 percent from 7.00 at Wednesday's midsession.
Five-year notes yielded 6.70 percent versus 6.68, and three-year notes yielded 6.16 percent versus 6.12.
The rises followed overnight increases in U.S. Treasury yields, an American bank dealer said.
